phase: Final polish + rights-gate acceptance. Phase 1 safe-area: xsg-navbar now computes the top inset dynamically from the platform statusBarHeight (px) with an env(safe-area-inset-top) fallback, so the custom navbar no longer receives env()=0 on Android; removed the duplicate page-level top inset on membership (.page padding-top) and profile (.container top padding), which stacked a second gap on iOS. Phase 2: the member-center paid bottom CTA no longer self-navigates to the membership purchase page (which is also the paid detail surface) — it scrolls in-page to the rights card, removing the member-center<->membership cycle and duplicate info-only surface. Phase 3: membership 查看会员详情 → member-center retained (one-way). Phase 4: verified each visible entitlement's server access path (AI/challenge/report/history/world-rules/growth_review) without claiming delivery where a dedicated member-only surface does not exist (world_rules: all 280 rows unlockLevel=free → no member-exclusive content; growth_review: permission exists but no dedicated route → recorded as requiring a feature build). No payment function / payment signing / callback / finalizer / membership or entitlement DB change.
scope: components/xsg-navbar/{xsg-navbar.js,xsg-navbar.wxml} (dynamic statusBarHeight inset + env fallback) + pages/membership/membership.wxss (remove duplicate top inset) + pages/profile/profile.wxss (remove container top padding; navbar owns inset) + pages/membership-center/{membership-center.js,membership-center.wxml} (paid CTA → in-page scroll, no self-navigation) + tests/rc8.13/member-polish.test.js (new, A-U) + tests/rc8.13/run.js + .changes/current-change.json.
